items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: It wasn't as much Bix as it was Trumbauer.

ctx.x: One of the things that always seemed odd to me also is... You know, in talking about "Singing The Blues," it's Trumbauer's solo that really seemed to stick in people's mind, and not so much Bix. And...
No, it wasn't. It wasn't as much Bix as it was Trumbauer.

And of course, the critics and practically everything you read, Bix is put in a much higher position than Red Nichols. Usually they say Red Nichols was just a Bix imitator, and then they put him in a...
